title: Operate and maintain registered water systems
what: Operate and maintain each registered system (such as a cooling tower or warm-water system) as its registration and the guidelines require.

sources.title: Public Health Act 1997 (Tas)
sources.quote: The owner of any premises where any registered system is installed must ensure that the system is operated and maintained – (a) in accordance with – (i) any condition of the registration;

reach.condition: if its premises have a cooling water system (such as a cooling tower)
